decision: GO for publication of the existing draft PR only; no approval to merge, deploy, install migration, or activate payments

observations.assessment: Order is locked before both pending-state checks and attempt validation. Failed/expired/refunded/inconsistent attempt states do not reset to pending. Amount, currency, expiry and capture identities remain bound. No provider callback is reached for a failure committed before claim.

Changed entry points take order then attempts in stable ID order and never later acquire batch; this introduces no new cycle with batch->order->attempt paths. Static reasoning is not a real concurrency proof.

Preparation preserves the original eligible session; claims preserve single-winner semantics and source/device-bound 3DS continuation. Already-paid/submitted handling is retained, and failed events do not rearm the row.

The change does not release failed capacity early. Existing reservation and webhook paths serialize on batch; paid after release remains cancelled with reconciliation. Immediate commercial recovery of the last slot remains intentionally unimplemented.

Known body/config/signature/privilege contracts are checked before either CREATE OR REPLACE. Unknown prerequisite or contract drift aborts the transaction and existing data/ACL/function definitions remain intact; exact fixed replay is accepted.

limits: Single PGlite backend queues statements; Promise.all covers request/transaction ordering but does not validate independent-session lock waits, MVCC overlap, deadlocks or production load.

No external schema inspection was performed. Only prepare, claim and confirmation are fingerprinted by the migration; actual deployed webhook, expiry, table, trigger and capacity definitions still require compatibility review before installation.
A provider operation whose claim committed before a later failure cannot be recalled by this SQL gate. Tests confirm no subsequent continuation rearms the failed row.
No real Culqi request, payment, live migration, credential change, deployment, merge, network workaround, or native PostgreSQL was performed by this reviewer.
Build and frontend/browser validation are outside this independent financial SQL review; parent is evaluating build separately.
